settings.editor: What are managed detection and response MDR services?

settings.title: Turn security signals into fast, confident action

settings.editor: Managed detection and response (MDR) services find suspicious activity, investigate potential threats, contain security incidents and coordinate the right response across your technology environment.
MDR goes past alerts. It connects detection, investigation, response, threat hunting and reporting, so your team knows what happened, what needs action and how to strengthen controls over time.

settings.editor: Spot suspicious activity before it grows into a major security incident.

Follow defined investigation, escalation, containment and response steps when an event needs action.
Use proactive threat hunting to find activity that standard detection misses.
Use investigation findings and incident insights to improve detection, response and controls.
Connect with our security team to scope your monitoring environment.

items.item_title: What are managed detection and response (MDR) services?
What is the difference between threat detection and incident response?
What types of threats can you investigate?
Can MDR work with our existing security tools?
What happens after a threat is detected?
Do you provide digital forensics support?

settings.editor: MDR services find suspicious activity, investigate potential threats, contain incidents and coordinate response, delivered by an external security team.
Threat detection finds malicious activity. Incident response investigates and acts when a security event needs further action.
Investigations can cover suspicious identity activity, endpoint threats, malware, unusual network behavior, application activity, cloud events and other security events in your environment.
Threat hunting is a proactive search for suspicious behaviors, indicators and attack patterns that haven’t triggered standard security alerts.
It depends on your security platforms, telemetry, integrations and environment. Detection scope is set based on what you already have and what you need.
The event is triaged and investigated to confirm its significance. If needed, it’s escalated, contained and handled through the defined incident response process.
Yes. Digital forensics is available when deeper investigation is needed to examine evidence, understand incident activity and establish timelines or attack paths.

settings.title: Know what’s happening and exactly what to do next

settings.editor: Folio3 managed detection and response services help you spot suspicious activity, investigate real threats and move from detection to action without delay.
